Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.pricing

Class KfeProductStatusMapper

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.in.http.dto.pricing.KfeProductStatusMapper
public final class KfeProductStatusMapper extends Object
Maps internal KfeTransactionStatus enum values to the canonical 7-state product status vocabulary exposed to clients.

Product states: PENDING, PROCESSING, CONFIRMING, COMPLETED, FAILED, NEEDS_REVIEW, REVERSED.

Unknown or null values map to PENDING (fail-safe).

Reference: docs/ops/PRODUCT_STATE_MAPPING.md
